3.speaker: Hugo Toras
3.text: "While I'm on the subject, a word about our houses."

7.speaker: Hugo Toras
7.text: "Our family currently controls the province of Valenqiris as well as the city-state of Iza."

8.speaker: Hugo Toras
8.text: "Aside from Iza, which is now under Rico's governance, all of Brenas is still their territory."

9.speaker: Hugo Toras
9.text: "The nobles there swore fealty to the crown in exchange for keeping a hold on their cities and their estates."

10.speaker: Hugo Toras
10.text: "But the return of Angelica's boy could test that loyalty. He is their rightful duke, after all, even if he does not admit it."

11.speaker: Hugo Toras
11.text: "Ah, yes. The rulers of Cardesse-Montaklar, and the stewards of the Rizian military."

16.speaker: Player_Romus
16.text: "Yes, I was saddened to hear. He taught me everything I know."

17.speaker: Player_Romus
17.text: "Yes. A shame I never got to know him."
17.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_JoinedMilitary"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_Studied"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_StayedOnCouncil"] == true) == false)

18.speaker: Player_Romus
18.text: "I hope the new war councilor is less of a hawk."

19.speaker: Hugo Toras
19.text: "His daughter Lucita, the Duchess of Montaklar, was selected to take his place as war and security councilor. You'll meet her later today."

20.speaker: Hugo Toras
20.text: "You should also know that factions within her province have begun calling for the return of Pales. Again."

21.speaker: Player_Romus
21.text: "My father was too soft on the Sazons. I'll keep them in line."

22.speaker: Player_Romus
22.text: "He cannot be a duke and claim to represent democratic values at the same time."

23.speaker: Player_Romus
23.text: "He lost that title when his father orchestrated my kidnapping."

24.speaker: Player_Romus
24.text: "Why? Cardesse-Montaklar is large and powerful enough."

25.speaker: Player_Romus
25.text: "The Azaros are warmongers, to a man. Or woman."

26.speaker: Player_Romus
26.text: "I won't let House Azaro down. I'll finish what the General started."

27.speaker: Player_Romus
27.text: "Pales hasn't been part of Rizia for over a century. It's a lost cause."

28.speaker: Hugo Toras
28.text: "A contradiction, isn't it? He discourages his fellow Delegates from using the title, but has yet to officially renounce it."

29.speaker: Hugo Toras
29.text: "No matter your feelings on the subject, I'd advise you to take the house's concerns seriously."

30.speaker: Hugo Toras
30.text: "Be careful. We all know how the last campaign against the Grand Duchy ended."

31.speaker: Hugo Toras
31.text: "Maybe so, but given the house's military might, I'd advise you to take their concerns seriously."

36.speaker: Hugo Toras
36.text: "Lucas was a rogue agent. Or so the rest of the house claims."

43.speaker: Hugo Toras
43.text: "At the moment, they're the weakest of the three houses. You'd do well to ensure they stay that way."

44.speaker: Player_Romus
44.text: "I wouldn't blame them for siding with him after House Toras stole Iza from them."

45.speaker: Hugo Toras
45.text: "They betrayed our house and our king. What else could have been done?"

49.speaker: Hugo Toras
49.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Briefing_Houses_ListenedToras"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Briefing_Houses_ListenedAzaro"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Briefing_Houses_ListenedToras"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Briefing_Houses_ListenedAzaro"] == true) == false)

50.speaker: Hugo Toras
50.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Briefing_Houses_ListenedToras"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Briefing_Houses_ListenedAzaro"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Briefing_Houses_ListenedToras"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Briefing_Houses_ListenedAzaro"] == true)

57.speaker: Hugo Toras
57.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Briefing_Houses_ListenedToras"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Briefing_Houses_ListenedSazon"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Briefing_Houses_ListenedToras"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Briefing_Houses_ListenedSazon"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_Focus_ArmedForces"] == true) == false)

58.speaker: Hugo Toras
58.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Briefing_Houses_ListenedToras"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Briefing_Houses_ListenedSazon"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Briefing_Houses_ListenedToras"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Briefing_Houses_ListenedSazon"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_Focus_ArmedForces"] == true) == false)

61.speaker: Narrator
61.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Briefing_Houses_ListenedToras"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Briefing_Houses_ListenedSazon"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Briefing_Houses_ListenedToras"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Briefing_Houses_ListenedAzaro"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Briefing_Houses_ListenedSazon"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Briefing_Houses_ListenedAzaro"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_Focus_ArmedForces"] == true) == false)

70.speaker: Player_Romus
70.text: "How is Valenqiris doing, now that I've left?"

71.speaker: Hugo Toras
71.text: "Stable as always. With you on the throne, me as Grand Vizier and Rico in Iza, the governing seat has been filled by our distant cousin Hubertus. You recall him, I'm sure."

72.speaker: Hugo Toras
72.text: "Of course, Princess Vina is eligible to take his place as the reigning Duchess once she is deemed fit."

77.speaker: Vina Toras
77.text: "In a few years, maybe. I still don't feel ready."

78.speaker: Player_Romus
78.text: "You'll go when I tell you to go."

79.speaker: Player_Romus
79.text: "You're already smarter than I was when I became Duke. But it's your decision."

80.speaker: Player_Romus
80.text: "Good. I'm not ready for you to live so far away."

90.speaker: Player_Romus
90.text: "She's already smarter than I was when I became Duke. But I don't want her living so far away."

95.speaker: Player_Romus
95.text: "What's really going on in Iza? Has Rico been well-received as Duke?"

97.speaker: Narrator
97.text: Hugo tapped his fingers on the table.

98.speaker: Hugo Toras
98.text: "In any case, Your Majesty, I don't expect any trouble in Valenqiris during your reign. It remains the wealthiest of Rizia's provinces, and the least affected by crime."

99.speaker: Hugo Toras
99.text: "Iza has been difficult since the Sazon rebellion. Even more so since the Wehzek population there exploded."

100.speaker: Hugo Toras
100.text: "Any effort to restore the rights and privileges of native Rizians is met with resistance. The students at Iza University are leading the charge, I believe."

101.speaker: Hugo Toras
101.text: "Considering the circumstances, I believe my son is doing just fine."

102.speaker: Player_Romus
102.text: "What about Rizia Imperii? We control that too, don't we?"

103.speaker: Hugo Toras
103.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Briefing_Houses_ListenedSazon"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Briefing_Houses_ListenedAzaro"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Briefing_Houses_ListenedSazon"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Briefing_Houses_ListenedAzaro"] == true) == false)

112.speaker: Hugo Toras
112.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Briefing_Houses_ListenedSazon"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Briefing_Houses_ListenedAzaro"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Briefing_Houses_ListenedSazon"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Briefing_Houses_ListenedAzaro"] == true)

113.speaker: Hugo Toras
113.text: "Make sure their lives don't get any less comfortable, and the local nobility will stay loyal to you."

114.speaker: Hugo Toras
114.text: "Yes, Porte Drazon and its metropolitan area are controlled by the central government, and therefore House Toras."

115.speaker: Hugo Toras
115.text: "You don't need to worry about pleasing our house in this region, though. It's more crucial to retain the favor of the major corporations that are based here."

116.speaker: Player_Romus
116.text: "Nonsense. It's the corporations who should be concerned with winning *my* favor."

118.speaker: Hugo Toras
118.text: "They are. In fact, the group took to the streets in celebration of your coronation."

119.speaker: Player_Romus
119.text: "It's not the Wehzeks who are the danger. It's bigotry."

120.speaker: Player_Romus
120.text: "I'll find a way to help him out."

122.speaker: Hugo Toras
122.text: "That would be most kind of you."

123.speaker: Hugo Toras
123.text: "The crime statistics are not bigoted, Your Majesty. If we do not acknowledge this problem, it will get worse."

124.speaker: Player_Romus
124.text: "Understood. If our economy takes a hit, another uprising won't be far behind."

126.speaker: Hugo Toras
126.text: "Some minor relations do. But most of our house's wealth comes from our land and natural gas holdings."

147.speaker: Hugo Toras
147.text: "The Pales Administrative District is also under the jurisdiction of Rizia Imperii since we won it back in the Reclamation War."

148.speaker: Hugo Toras
148.text: "Lest we forget, Wehlen is scheduled to return Zille to Rizia next year. The Sazons expect the region to become part of their province, as it was before the uprising."

149.speaker: Player_Romus
149.text: "The power balance between the houses is fragile enough. Adding so much land to Brenas would upset it beyond repair."

151.speaker: Player_Romus
151.text: "I can use it as a bargaining chip. Stay loyal to the crown, or no Zille for House Sazon."

152.speaker: Hugo Toras
152.text: "As king, you have the authority to make Zille part of the central government, similar to Rizia Imperii. An option to keep in mind."

154.speaker: Player_Romus
154.text: "I don't see any downside to that."

155.speaker: Hugo Toras
155.text: "It's a lot of land, including two strategic harbors. Allowing the Sazons to regain the power they had before the uprising would be unwise."

156.speaker: Hugo Toras
156.text: "You must be aware of their patriarch Taddeus' poor health. The General suffered a stroke just prior to King Valero's death."

168.speaker: Hugo Toras
168.text: "You've already made strengthening the Rizian armed forces a high priority. That should endear you to them right off the bat."

169.speaker: Hugo Toras
169.text: "As for Angelica herself... she remains in exile. As she should."

170.speaker: Player_Romus
170.text: "Exile's too good for her. Why can't I just have her killed?"

173.speaker: Hugo Toras
173.text: "Aside from the fact that doing so would turn all of Brenas against you... there is no evidence she did anything wrong."

174.speaker: Hugo Toras
174.text: "There are even whispers that she turned her husband in not to save her own skin, but to aid in the monarchy's preservation."

175.speaker: Player_Romus
175.text: "She did nothing wrong. Why does she still have to suffer for it after all these years?"

176.speaker: Hugo Toras
176.text: "The Sazon matriarch is a powerful figure, Your Majesty. Even all these years later, she commands the loyalty of the entire province of Brenas."

177.speaker: Hugo Toras
177.text: "I do not deny that she could be a useful ally. But only as long as you stay on her house's good side."

178.speaker: Player_Romus
178.text: "If Angelica is in exile and Manus has not laid claim to the Duke position, who's officially in charge of Brenas now?"

180.speaker: Hugo Toras
180.text: "A lesser relation by the name of Leona. She reigns from Sallabes."

181.speaker: Hugo Toras
181.text: "But it is Manus and Angelica that the rest of the Sazons take their cues from."

185.speaker: Hugo Toras
185.text: "From what I've been hearing, the PR campaign you spearheaded over the last several years endeared you to them greatly. Keep up the good work."

186.speaker: Player_Romus
186.text: "No need to continue. I'm up to speed on the houses' activities."

188.speaker: Hugo Toras
188.text: "I see. Then this will be a short meeting indeed."

192.speaker: Hugo Toras
192.text: "They are working with Ricardus to preserve whatever fragile order exists in the city, yes."

196.speaker: Player_Romus
196.text: "May God bless him with a full recovery."
